citations.assertion: Named deceased cooper. The original Pittsylvania death register for 1860 has now been inspected at FamilySearch DGS 004225404, full-film image 316, entry indexed as the 37th. James Glasgow’s row records 28 September, cause “Killed,” age 71 years 10 months 12 days, and occupation cooper. Susan Glasgow is the named informant, explicitly described as his wife. The Names of Parents cell on James’s row is blank. The parent names on the immediately preceding John Gammon row do not belong to James. No birthplace wording or ditto mark is visible in James’s own Where Born cell in the inspected row; the held Pittsylvania birthplace remains an index/transcription attribution, not a newly confirmed literal entry on this image. The county appears in the register heading. The consort column likewise does not supply a named spouse; Susan is identified through the informant columns. The full age is reported information, not a birth-register entry: calculating a birthday from it does not create independent birth evidence. The original confirms the already indexed death date, trade, age and wife/informant but supplies no parent. James’s father remains Unknown and unrated; all current vital fields and family relationships are retained. James Glasgow: Named deceased cooper Reviewed 2026-10-31; Original source link and private normal-provider download preserved31October2026. Existing canonical ID and primary transcription URL retained; original and legacy index added as same-event supporting sources. No father or vital-field change.
